views.name: installer_category_stats
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id) AS installer_id,
    t.category,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.minutes IS NOT NULL) AS n,
    percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (e.minutes::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE e.minutes IS NOT NULL) AS median_minutes,
    avg(e.quality_grade) FILTER (WHERE e.quality_grade IS NOT NULL) AS avg_grade
   FROM install_events e
     JOIN window_types t ON t.id = e.window_type_id
  WHERE COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id) IS NOT NULL AND t.category IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_test_profile(COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id))
  GROUP BY (COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id)), t.category;

views.name: installer_type_stats
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id) AS installer_id,
    e.window_type_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.minutes IS NOT NULL) AS n,
    percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (e.minutes::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE e.minutes IS NOT NULL) AS median_minutes,
    avg(e.quality_grade) FILTER (WHERE e.quality_grade IS NOT NULL) AS avg_grade,
    count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.quality_grade <= 2 OR q.status = 'callback'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric AS fail_rate,
    max(e.created_at) AS last_at
   FROM install_events e
     LEFT JOIN qc_checks q ON q.project_opening_id = e.project_opening_id
  WHERE COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id) IS NOT NULL AND e.window_type_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_test_profile(COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id))
  GROUP BY (COALESCE(e.credited_to, e.installer_id)), e.window_type_id;

views.name: project_scope_counts
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS project_id,
    count(o.id) AS openings,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'installed'::text) AS installed,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.unit_kind = 'window'::text) AS windows,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.unit_kind = 'door'::text) AS doors,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.door_kind = 'slider'::text) AS door_sliders,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.door_kind = 'french'::text) AS door_french,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.door_kind = 'bifold'::text) AS door_bifold,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.door_kind = 'swing'::text) AS door_swing,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.door_kind = 'other'::text) AS door_other,
    count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE s.unit_kind IS NULL) AS unknown_units
   FROM projects p
     LEFT JOIN project_openings o ON o.project_id = p.id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ms.unit_kind,
            ms.door_kind
           FROM project_mark_specs ms
          WHERE ms.project_id = p.id AND upper(ms.mark_code) = upper(mark_base(o.opening_code))
          ORDER BY ms.confirmed DESC, ms.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) s ON true
  GROUP BY p.id;
